title: Fox's Old Amanita Block Models
description: old clover (for now, maybe there's more stuff i'll change) models based on vanilla frogspawn blocks
body:
with updates coming to my hit minecraft mod, recently, the clover blocks have gotten a lot of new model and texture changes, this resourcepack brings back old clover textures! (maybe not ONLY clovers with time? if there's demand for it...)
i dunno why you'd use this! maybe you liked the simplicity of the old textures??? or maybe the gridlike pattern of the old clover blocks?? who knows!
